capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database nominal 60 kWh for the CATL LFP Model Y RWD (Shanghai-built); InsideEVs/Electrek say Canada gets this Shanghai LFP RWD from 2023. The powertrain also carries a US 2024 RWD edition (EPA 418 km); a TMC thread reports US RWD cars use CATL LFP software-limited below 60 kWh, but that page was blocked, so the pack is assumed the same.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database useable 57 kWh (site estimate) for the same CATL LFP pack. The powertrain also carries a US 2024 RWD edition (EPA 418 km); a TMC thread reports US RWD cars use CATL LFP software-limited below 60 kWh, but that page was blocked, so the pack is assumed the same.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database: LFP cathode, CATL.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database: 400 V architecture (340 V nominal, 108s).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 170 kW DC for the CATL LFP RWD.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport: Standard RWD and AWD are at the 7.7 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America). Wikipedia says up to 11.5 kW on all variants, ArenaEV/EV Database list 11 kW (EU), so sources conflict; Tesla Model 3 service manual says 48 A only with the Long Range battery. EV Database lists 11 kW (EU 3-phase, usually 7.4 kW in practice) for the CATL pack; North American single-phase assumed 7.7 kW.
